newsitem.title: UK: Cinven gets 300 mln stg for new venture fund.
newsitem.headline: Cinven gets 300 mln stg for new venture fund.

text.p: British venture capital company Cinven announced on Monday it had closed its first venture capital fund with commitments of 300 million stg.

The capital for the closed-end 10-year fund, raised from North America, continental Europe and the Middle East, would be invested in Britain and mainland Europe, the company said in a statement. The offer period closed on November 15. The fund will invest alongside Cinven's three other clients -- British Coal Pension schemes, Railways Pension Schemes and Barclays Bank Pension Fund, the statement said. Another client, Royal Life Insurance, will now invest through the fund.

The focus is expected to be on larger buyouts valued at over 10 million stg. One of the first investments will be Newsquest Media Co, after the government approved the media firm's 305 million stg acquisition of Westminster Press from Pearson Plc.
Cinven had a management buy-out from British Coal in October 1995. It now manages some 1.0 billion stg on behalf of clients.
